W	Thank you so much for organizing the annual company picnic, Jingdao. Everybody seemed to enjoy it.
M	Well, we deserved it after working so hard this year.
W	I agree. The food was great, by the way. Especially the peach pie you made. Would you mind sharing the recipe? It was delicious.
M	I found the recipe online. I’ll send you a link to the Web page. There's a really helpful video that walks you through all the steps. I recommend you watch it first.
W	All right, thanks.

M	I'd like to finish calculating the company’s expense reports for the month. Have you finished reviewing the travel reimbursement forms from all the departments?
W	almost done, but I have a question about a hotel receipt from one of our employees.
M	the problem?
W	Well, our policy is for employees to stay at a hotel that’s on our list of approved accommodations. This one isn’t on the list.
M	Who submitted the receipt?
W	one of our sales representatives.
M	a new employee and may have forgotten the policy. Asa supervisor, can approve the expense this one time.

M	Good morning, Damilola. How’s everything up here on deck?
W	Hi, Pedro. It was an uneventful night, and our cargo ship still hasn't moved yet.
M	I hope the fog over the harbor lifts soon.
W	The ship won't be able to leave until the weather improves.
M	I hope we won’t get too far behind schedule. I’ll be sure to call the port authority soon for an update on when we'll be cleared to leave.

W	Hi. I’ve made a reservation to meet with some clients for lunch today. It’s under Cohen.
M	yes. I see your reservation. Welcome, Ms. Cohen.
W	I know I asked to be seated on your beautiful terrace, but it’s very hot today.
M	I can seat you at table four inside. Do you mind waiting a few minutes?
W	Not at all. By the way, your parking area’s nearly full. Where can I tel! my clients to park?
M	Our customers can park for free in the garage across the street. Our cashier will stamp their parking tickets.
W	great. Thanks. I ll call them and let them know.

W	Thank you both for coming here today to demonstrate your company’s new compact printer. I know the store will be busy because we're having a big sale on laptop computers and tablets.
M	We’re happy to be here. Our printers are perfect for students or people with home offices who may have limited space. My partner, Murat, will be setting up the printer station.
M	can I put our demonstration table?
W	show you the area. Also, if you brought any brochures with you, it'll be helpful to put those out for people to take.

W	and Hector, I’m very pleased with the sales of our brands of cakes, pies, and cookies this past holiday season. Any thoughts on what we should be concentrating on going forward?
W	The biggest trend right now is the reduction of sugar. The public wants healthier products, but the same great taste. That'll be our biggest challenge.
M	One of our ingredient suppliers recently started offering a sweetener made entirely from natural ingredients.
W	Are there similar ones on the market? And how do they compare?
M	I'd have to do some investigation to find out more about that. I have some time available tomorrow afternoon.

M	Hi, Bianca. I'm calling to see if you'd have time to work on a project for my marketing firm. We've expanded a lot in the past year, and we need some help.
W	Thanks for thinking of me. What type of work would I be doing?
M	Well, we have a new client in Brazil who’s interested in creating a marketing campaign for social media sites. You'd be overseeing the campaign.
W	I have experience with that. Why don’t you send me a detailed description of the work? That'll give me an idea of how much time this project will take.

W	We were about to pack van number five for the music festival when we noticed it's got a flat tire.
M	not good.
W	We're supposed to get there by eleven to set up lunch for the performers. Is there another van we can take?
M	Let me see what's available. We've gota lot of catering jobs today. Ah, yes—we can use van number three. Do you need help loading?
W	Yes, thanks. The food's already in coolers, but everything’s in the kitchen with the serving utensils and napkins. It all needs to be brought to the parking area.
M	All right; I can help with that.

M	Thanks for taking my call. As I mentioned in my e-mail, I'm interested in working in your field. But I’m talking to some professionals first so I can find out more about it.
W	Happy to help.
M	So how did you get your start?
W	my family always subscribed to three newspapers. So I always thought the news was important. At my university, I joined the newspaper and eventually worked my way up to being an editor.
M	Is it true that people in the news business work very long hours? So what's your schedule like?

M	Hi, Karen! I just read the article on the company Web site about the proposed merger with QZ Corporation. It looks like we're going ahead with it.
W	There would be a lot of advantages to merging operations, although they also talked about it last year.
M	I remember that. But there were a lot of details to work out—like whether our offices would stay in Chicago. Nowit looks like we won't be relocating.
W	Well, I really don’t want to move, so that’s a relief.

M	Thanks for calling Customized Concepts. How can I help you?
W	My company wants to give every employee a gift, something useful but not too big. Since we’re about to host our annual staff basketball tournament, thought a water bottle might be good.
M	We carry a few drink containers. If you’re at our Web site, you'll see them under the Lifestyle tab.
W	Let me pull it up now... All right.
M	I recommend the metal bottle with the wide-mouthed lid. It’s easier to clean than the one with the straw.
W	thanks. And you could put our company logo on it, right?
M	Yes. You'll just need to send me the graphic file.
W	I can do that.

W	I just finished recording the audio guide for the pencil drawings that'll be included in our modern art exhibit next week. The files’ll be loaded onto the audio devices tomorrow.
M	great. But, unfortunately, we have to make one change. The drawing by Claudia Hoffman will no longer be in the exhibit. There was a scheduling mix-up, and it was promised to another museum starting next week.
W	too bad. That was one of my favorite pieces. Will you put anything in its place?
M	No. We'll just remove it.
W	then I’ll make that change to the audio-guide recording. I’ll do that right away.

M	glad we were assigned to cover the press conference earlier today. I counted seven other major media networks there, in addition to ours.
W	Well, the offshore wind industry is going to transform the way this region gets its power.
M	Agreed. Let's compare our facts before we start writing.
W	So the largest cluster of wind turbines— off the coast of Winston—is already built. The other sites are at different stages of construction, though Lanchester is also close to being done.
M	Right. And I think it’s crucial for us to focus on how many new jobs related to assembling and maintaining the turbines are opening up in the area as a result of this.

Welcome to Your House Works. On today’s episode, we'll go over how you can maintain and make minor repairs to the roof of your home. The first thing to do is to invest in a few special tools, like a trowel and crowbar. It's important to choose some that are high quality because you'll use them for many years. With your trowel and some roof cement, you can seal any cracks or chips. The crowbar will help you remove loose shingles that you can then replace. Now, highly recommend you take photos of your roof every year so that you can track its overall condition.

Thanks again for joining me on today’s tour of the beautiful Wallingford Conservatory. hope you enjoyed seeing and learning about the many species of plants and flowers we care for here. As I mentioned at the beginning of the tour, world-renowned botanist Samantha Hughes will be giving a lecture on the care of flowering orchid plants at two o'clock in the community room. I recommend attending. Samantha’s work has also been featured in a documentary film called Orchid Caretakers, which you can purchase through the conservatory’s online gift shop. I! watched it recently and learned many new things about the orchid species we have right here at the conservatory.

Before the benefit concert begins, I want to thank all of you for supporting the Hillcaster Community Center. As you know, I our facilities have been in need of some repairs for quite a while. So far, we've raised 5,000 dollars in ticket sales, but we haven’‘t quite reached our goal yet. So during the concert, I want to encourage you to buy food and drinks from the concession stand. Eighty percent of the proceeds will go to construction at the Hillcaster Community Center. Enjoy the music!

Thank you ali for attending today’s workshop. Erina Kimura and I will be conducting the session, and we'll be focusing on using time efficiently as a business owner. Planning and spending your time wisely is a key factor to business success. During the presentation, I’ll be referring to documents from the packet you were handed as you arrived. If you don’t have one yet, Erina’s at the back of the room. OK then, to start off, we'll do an exercise to get to know one another better.

At this site, archaeologists have uncovered the remains of a fifth-century marketplace with colorful mosaic tiles on the walls. You'll notice how vibrant the colors are, even after all these centuries. This is what the ruins are most famous for. You can still see intricate details in the artists’ pictures of scenes from daily life. Now, to protect the mosaics, a roof has been constructed over the area, and the lights are dim. And I'm sorry, but taking photos is not allowed, as the flash would damage the tiles. As we proceed, please hold on to the handrails on either side. They'll help you stay on the path and protect the ruins around us.

As you all know, our agency’s just won an important contract with Parker Auto Parts Company. We'll be developing two 30-second ads for local radio stations to be released next month and two additional 20-second ads for the following month. Now, I know it’s a tight schedule, but this is a priority. The client has actually started trying to work on this internally, so there's a rough ad we can start editing. Let's work on that now.

We'll be walking around the pond and along the renovated walking trail. We'll end our walk on the hill on the north side of the park. There we'll be having some free snacks and ice cream. For those of you taking photos, don’t forget to post them on the city’s Web site. We'd like to commemorate this special day.

Thanks, everyone, for attending today’s free public lecture, sponsored by the Springfield Farmers’ Association. So, we've received lots of requests for information on growing a vegetable garden. People want to know how to keep their garden healthy and get the vegetables they want. The first thing we recommend is regular soil testing. Since this is September, all soil samples in the next six weeks should be taken from the same depth, as seen on this chart. Oh, and before you leave today, please sign up for our mailing list to stay informed of future lectures.
